proposal.root_cause: Failure to adhere to explicit calculation formulas in hints (e.g., SUM/COUNT instead of AVG) and incorrect interpretation of 'Top N per group' (returning distinct names instead of full ranked lists)
proposal.what: Update system_prompt.md to strictly enforce using the exact arithmetic formula provided in hints for aggregations (preventing AVG substitution for SUM/COUNT which changes NULL handling/precision) and clarify that 'top N per group' questions usually require returning all rows meeting the rank condition, not just distinct entity names.
